description: CI drops the test step, switches to pull_request_target and grants write permissions.

files.base:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: cargo fmt --check
      - run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo test --workspace
files.head:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request_target:
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: cargo fmt --check
      - run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings
